name: Spiderweb Sonnet
source:
It is a short visual novel about a certain poet, who is forced to make difficult decisions on his way to a well-deserved dinner.

[From [url=https://gargoolia.itch.io/spiderweb-sonnet-wip]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部关于某位诗人的短篇视觉小说——在前往享用一顿当之无愧的晚餐途中，他被迫做出一连串艰难的抉择。

[引自[url=https://gargoolia.itch.io/spiderweb-sonnet-wip]Itch.io[/url]]
